title: T. Rex Dinosaur Could Become Most Expensive Fossil Ever
description: In 1997, Sotheby's hosted a natural history auction selling wonders of our prehistoric world - but for the first time a dinosaur was on the books. It was a niche event mostly attended by the world's museums looking for specimens to add to their collections. The dinosaur in question was a Tyrannosaurus Rex called Sue - she was eventually sold for $8 million (£6 million) to the Field Museum in Chicago.

title: Ancient New Kingdom Tomb Unearthed In Egypt's Luxor
description: Archaeologists have uncovered a New Kingdom-era tomb in Luxor's Theban Necropolis, revealing colorful wall paintings and inscriptions that could offer fresh insights into ancient Egyptian burial practices.
